subject: POC trial planning & RACI - VerdantHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@verdanthealth.com>, Dana Morris <dana.morris@verdanthealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial planning & RACI - VerdantHealth

Thanks again for taking the time today – great conversation. Per our call, here's a short recap and proposed next steps to get the POC/trial moving quickly. Please confirm or flag changes.

Summary of goals / success criteria (from Verdant):
- Evaluate Redwood inference for integrating real-time summarization into the clinician workflow (latency <= 350ms p50, accuracy: >90% match to internal QA prompts).
- Throughput target: sustain ~30 req/s during peak clinic hours.
- Data controls: patient PHI must remain within Verdant VPC / private deployment; audit logs required for every inference call.

Evaluation plan / timeline (proposed):
- Week 1 (Mar 8–12): Access & onboarding. Provision dedicated trial environment (private cluster), share sample prompts/datasets, complete security questionnaire.
- Week 2 (Mar 15–19): Integration pilot with sample app endpoint + latency/load tests.
- Week 3 (Mar 22–26): Clinical QA evaluation against 200 real examples, collect qualitative feedback from 3 clinicians.
- Week 4 (Mar 29–Apr 2): Final report + decision meeting.

Ownership / RACI (first pass) – please confirm owners below:
- Redwood infra/private deployment: Aditya Rao (Owner) – provisioning, network setup, KMS integration.
- Redwood integration / SDK & app support: Lauren Bishop (Primary SE) – client integration, sample code, runbook.
- InfoSec / questionnaire & compliance: Verdant InfoSec + Redwood security (Neha Kapoor) (Consulted).
- Procurement / commercial: Verdant procurement (Dana / Kelsey) (Responsible for contract sign-off).
- Executive sponsor / success metrics: Tom Erickson (A/R).

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Tom/Dana: confirm the success criteria above and identify Verdant internal owners for InfoSec and Procurement (name + email).
2) Verdant: can you provide a 1–2 week window for access to a sanitized sample dataset for QA?
3) Redwood (Aditya): estimate for time to provision private trial environment + any prerequisites.
4) I'll attach a working RACI spreadsheet and the Redwood security questionnaire for your review.

Attachments: Verdant_POCRACI_v1.xlsx (skeleton RACI), Redwood_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

Thanks – I'll set up a quick 30-min sync once owners are identified.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@verdanthealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dana Morris <dana.morris@verdanthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial planning & RACI - VerdantHealth

Marissa – thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- InfoSec owner: Our lead for vendor assessments is Kelsey Grant (kelsey.grant@verdanthealth.com). I'll loop her in once we have the questionnaire and RACI.
- Procurement/legal: I'm the internal sponsor but procurement will own contract ops – Dana (cc'd) will coordinate.
- PHI/data: We need the trial to run in our VPC with HSM-backed KMS. Is that supported in the private deployment? Please confirm any limitations (e.g., model variants, quantization, or latency impacts).

Timing: the week ranges look good. We prefer provisioning the environment the week of Mar 8 so we can start integration early the following week.

Can you also confirm the dedicated capacity guidance (GPUs) you'll provision for the 30 req/s target and expected per-token cost for the trial?

I'll add Kelsey after you send the questionnaire. If you can propose two times for a 30-min kickoff this week or early next (Mar 5 or Mar 8), we'll pick one.

Thanks,
Tom
Director, Clinical Innovation | VerdantHealth
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@verdanthealth.com>, Dana Morris <dana.morris@verdanthealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial planning & RACI - VerdantHealth

Thanks Tom – great questions. Quick answers and updates inline: 

- Private deployment & VPC: Yes – we can run the trial in a Verdant VPC via our Private deployment (customer-managed networking). Aditya: ETA?
- HSM-backed KMS: Supported via integrations with AWS KMS (customer-managed keys) and optional HSM partners; Neha, I've flagged this for a deeper security note.
- Dedicated capacity sizing: For 30 req/s and target latency, recommendation is 2x A100-equivalent GPUs with autoscale headroom for spikes. Estimated trial cost (rough): $X/day (I'll confirm numbers with ops and include a short cost breakdown).

Aditya Rao (cc) – can you confirm provisioning time for a trial private cluster and list any networking prerequisites (VPC peering, IP allowlists, required ports)?
Neha Kapoor (cc) – I'm attaching the Redwood security questionnaire (filled where possible). Can you add any notes re: required attestations we should prep for Kelsey?

Proposed kickoff: Fri, Mar 5, 10:30am PT OR Mon, Mar 8, 10:00am PT – which works for you? I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Action items captured: 
- Marissa: share RACI + questionnaire (attached) and draft provisioning checklist.
- Aditya: provisioning ETA + networking prerequisites.
- Verdant (Tom/Dana): confirm Kelsey as InfoSec point and sample dataset window.

Attachments: Verdant_POCRACI_v1.xlsx, Redwood_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

Best,
Marissa
From: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@verdanthealth.com>

Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 11:45:00 -07:00

Marissa – thanks, that all sounds good. Kelsey is on this thread now (InfoSec). She'll review the questionnaire and follow up with any gap requests. Dana confirmed procurement will touch base separately about our standard MSA redlines.

We can commit to a sanitized sample dataset the week of Mar 15 for the clinical QA run if Redwood can provision the private environment the week of Mar 8. Confirming kickoff: Mon, Mar 8, 10:00am PT works for us. Please send the calendar invite.

Quick note on ownership (confirming your RACI mapping):
- Infra/private deployment: Aditya Rao (Redwood) – Owner
- Integration / SDK / runbooks: Lauren Bishop (Redwood) – Owner / Day-to-day SE
- Security questionnaire & attestations: Kelsey Grant (Verdant InfoSec) – Responsible; Neha Kapoor (Redwood) – Contact/Consulted
- Procurement & legal: Dana Morris (Verdant) – Responsible

Next steps:
- Marissa: calendar invite for kickoff (Mon Mar 8, 10:00am PT) + provisioning checklist + updated RACI workbook.
- Aditya: provide provisioning ETA and any network artifacts needed by EOD Thu Mar 4.
- Kelsey: will review questionnaire and get back by Fri Mar 6.

Thanks – looking forward to getting started.

Tom
